      - "!**/CLAUDE.md"
      - "!**/AGENTS.md"
      - "!**/README.md"
      - "!**/docs/**"
      - "!**/specs/**"
      - "!**/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**"
      - "!**/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/**"
      - "!**/.claude/**"
      - "!**/CLAUDE.md"
      - "!**/AGENTS.md"
      - "!**/README.md"

jobs:
  codeql-skip:
    name: Skip CodeQL Analysis
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (contains(github.event.pull_request.changed_files, 0) || 
      (github.event.pull_request.changed_files == 0 && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main'))
    steps:
      - name: Skip CodeQL Analysis
        run: |
          echo "Skipping CodeQL analysis as only documentation/config files were changed."
          exit 0
